en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a European town with dense two- to three‑storey buildings, many with steep tiled roofs. A straight, relatively wide street runs from the lower right into the distance, bordered by multi-storey houses or factory buildings; smoke rises from a chimney in the right foreground. In the background are several church towers and large institutional-looking buildings on a hill, along with patches of trees and gardens. The architecture is characteristic of a late‑19th or early‑20th‑century Central European town. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
